articles.title: Utah moves to drop criminal pursuit of Kalshi after the firm halted services there
articles.snippet: The state continues to hold the criminal charges in its back pocket with a vow to hit Kalshi and other prediction markets with gambling accusations if they return.

articles.title: South Korea proposes ending 2017 ICO ban to boost jobs and onshore crypto investment
articles.snippet: Token issuers would have to disclose how they plan to spend investors' money and could face criminal charges for misleading buyers.

articles.title: Bitcoin drops as November spot ETF outflows increase to record $4.71 billion
Bitcoin hands back Monday's Nvidia-driven gains, liquidations triple
articles.snippet: Bitcoin (BTC) has dropped 2.2% since midnight UTC to around $59,900, giving back Monday's jump and lagging the stock market's rebound from last week's selloff.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s drop to $55,000 left a record 11.6 million BTC underwater
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s supply in profit fell below its 2022 FTX collapse low, while entities holding 100 to 10,000 BTC continued to accumulate.
